title: Exchange: Enable High Volume Email (HVE) for External Recipients
description: High Volume Email (HVE) External Sending extends HVE in Exchange Online, which today sends only to recipients inside your organization, so it can also deliver bulk email to external recipients such as customers and partners. It is designed for operational and transactional messages, like notifications, alerts, receipts and required communications, and not for marketing campaigns. Apps and devices send through SMTP using HVE account authentication. Admins turn the feature on for specific HVE accounts with a cmdlet. Built-in throttling, quotas and suppression of problem recipients help protect your sending reputation. Billing will be based on usage, per external recipient.
